text: Card Folder is a React payment card component that shows a landscape card tucked into a stitched purse pocket. Pressing it lifts the card forward while the purse compresses into its bottom seam, and a separate eye button reveals the full card number and CVV with a rolling digit swap. The open state and the detail visibility are each controlled or uncontrolled, and an optional overflow action button sits beside the card. It is built with Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS.When to use itA fintech or banking app shows a virtual card that users can lift out to view.A wallet screen hides card numbers by default and reveals them only on request.A card management page needs a per-card actions button for tasks like freezing or replacing a card.AccessibilityThe card is a button with aria-expanded and a default label that reads the title, the last four digits and the expiry, such as "Open Travel card, card ending in 4242, expires 08/29"; ariaLabel replaces it. The detail toggle is a separate button named "Show card details" or "Hide card details" with aria-pressed, and while the card is lifted the purse layer is inert and hidden from assistive technology. With reduced motion enabled, the purse fades instead of compressing and the card does not lift.FAQHow do I build an animated credit card component in React?Render CardFolder with title, cardNumber, expiry and cvv, and pass your card artwork as the card prop. cardClassName styles the card surface.How do I hide the card number by default?Details start hidden, showing only the last four digits and a masked CVV. Use defaultDetailsVisible for uncontrolled use, or detailsVisible with onDetailsVisibleChange to control it.Can I add a menu button to the card?Yes. Pass onAction to render an overflow button next to the card, and actionLabel to name it (it defaults to "Open actions for" followed by the title).
